item.title: A popemobile exhibition is unveiled at the Vatican, featuring the vehicle popes have used since 1930
item.description: The Vatican is opening a celebration of the popemobile. The now-iconic vehicle has allowed popes to get close to the faithful at home and abroad for nearly a century.

item.title: Thousands in Kosovo demand state action after 8 women die this year in domestic violence
item.description: Angry protesters have splashed red paint on government buildings in Kosovo during a protest demanding state action over widespread violence against women in the staunchly patriarchal Balkan country.

item.title: Suspects in alleged school shooting plot in Georgia had floor plan, had chosen a date, warrants show
item.description: Authorities say that the suspects in an alleged plot to carry out a shooting at a Georgia high school had a floor plan of the school and had chosen a date.

item.title: Yaxley-Lennon, better known as Tommy Robinson, found guilty of harassing British journalists
item.description: The far-right British activist Stephen Yaxley-Lennon, who is better known by his pseudonym Tommy Robinson, has been found guilty of harassing two journalists and causing them to fear being subjected to violence.
